objectives: Demonstrate accurate reading across taught final consonant spelling patterns.

concepts: Taught final spellings include -dge and -ge for /j/, -tch for /ch/, and -ck for /k/ in their respective contexts.
Use the whole spelling pattern rather than guessing.
Fresh examples test transfer beyond memorised responses.

workedExamples.prompt: Compare “badge”, “page”, “catch” and “duck”. What should a reader identify?
workedExamples.solution: Identify -dge, -ge, -tch and -ck respectively, then read each whole word.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner swaps two endings. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Compare the complete word with conventional spelling and practise the target ending.
